mapper.insert: insert into agent_session_summary (session_id, summary, summary_until_seq, version, created_at, updated_at) values (#{sessionId}, #{summary}, #{summaryUntilSeq}, #{version}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update agent_session_summary set summary = #{summary}, summary_until_seq = #{untilSeq}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where session_id = #{sessionId} and version = #{expectedVersion}
